function.name: prime_numbers_in_range

message.reasoning: The user asks: "尋找從紐約到波士頓的最快路線。" Chinese: "Find the fastest route from New York to Boston." They want directions. We need to provide a route. We can give approximate driving route: I-95 N, etc. Provide details: distance ~215 miles, about 3.5-4 hours. Provide alternative: I-84 W, I-90 W, etc. Provide travel time, traffic. Provide suggestions. No tool needed.
